args.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s1.session) AS unique_sessions
FROM log.main.form_log s1
JOIN log.main.form_log s2
  ON s1.session = s2.session
  AND s1.path = '/regist/input'
  AND s2.path = '/regist/confirm'
  AND s1.stamp < s2.stamp
SELECT path, COUNT(*) FROM log.main.form_log GROUP BY path
SELECT * FROM log.main.form_log WHERE path IN ('/regist/input', '/regist/confirm') ORDER BY session, stamp
